return_policy: 30-day return policy. Items must be unopened or defective. Original receipt required. Opened non-defective items are not eligible for return.

laptops.name: Lenovo Legion 5 Pro Gen 9
laptops.thermal_notes: Excellent thermal performance. Dual-fan Coldfront 5.0 cooling system. Sustained full TDP under extended gaming and rendering loads with minimal throttling.

laptops.name: ASUS ROG Strix G16 (2024)
laptops.thermal_notes: Good thermals under gaming loads. Tri-fan MUX Switch design. Can run warm during prolonged rendering sessions; recommend using Turbo mode for sustained workloads.

laptops.name: Acer Nitro V 15
laptops.thermal_notes: Decent thermals for the price. Dual-fan cooling adequate for casual gaming; may throttle under sustained 4K video exports.

laptops.name: HP Victus 15
laptops.thermal_notes: Above-average battery for a gaming laptop. Thermal performance is adequate but not class-leading; throttles after ~30 min of sustained GPU load.

laptops.name: MSI Katana 15
laptops.thermal_notes: Solid cooling with 6 heat pipes. Good sustained performance for video editing. Runs slightly louder than competition under full load.

laptops.name: Dell G15 (2024)
laptops.thermal_notes: Best-in-class battery life for a gaming laptop in this range. Thermal performance conservative by design — excellent for travel use but GPU headroom is limited.
